entries.name: Sha-chi Furnace Inspection Crank
entries.desc: A grease-stained round crank, slightly warped by unrelenting heat. Small lettering is engraved on the handle: "Inspection Port No. 2 Control Console, Lower Level, Sha-Chi Forging Furnace."

entries.name: Crystal Puppet Eye [yang]
entries.desc:
A crystal puppet eye with a white, fish-shaped form visible within, resembling the Yang half of a taiji symbol.

It forms a pair with another crystal eye containing the Yin half.

entries.name: Hansui's Frost Mask
entries.desc:
A mask formed from hardened ice and Phantom Arts, impervious to flame and impossible to shatter.

The Forbidden Ruins have been sealed shut ever since an intruder caused havoc within. Even the four Acolytes tasked with hunting down traitors can no longer enter on their own.

entries.name: Rusted Loong Key
entries.desc:
A key fashioned in the shape of a Loong. The gem that once sat in its eye is long gone, and the golden scales have been stripped away by human hands. Yet beneath the rust, the key still hints at the prosperity of its former owner.

What is sealed away behind the gate it was made to open?

entries.name: Sha-chi Tower Base Camp Gate Key
entries.desc:
A crudely pieced-together key. The original had snapped, and its teeth were hastily fastened onto a short metal shaft.

Opens the camp gate leading to the base of the Sha-Chi Tower.

entries.name: Cell Key
entries.desc:
A prison key found in the pocket of a Mandate disciple. It is unclear which cell in the Valley Outpost it unlocks.

To this day, the Mandate has found no answer to Transcension. Once they find one of their own undergoes Transcension, confinement remains the safest option, even if they are still lucid.

entries.desc:
A crystal puppet eye with a white, fish-shaped form visible within, resembling the Yang half of a taiji symbol.

It forms a pair with another crystal eye containing the Yin half.

entries.name: Vessel Restorative
entries.desc:
An angular metal container with a yellowed note stuck to the bottom: "Administered to No. 13. Recovery results were excellent. Further modification and research recommended."

Restores 70% HP and increases natural Sha-Chi recovery speed by 50% for 5 seconds.

entries.name: Reflex Device
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Increases the timing windows for Parry and Perfect Dodge by 15%.

An intricate object that even the Transcension Furnace cannot refine. When worn, the instant a blade draws near and death closes in, the body reacts before the mind. Not merely faster, but at precisely the right moment.

entries.name: Token Of Pursuit
entries.desc:
Increases damage dealt to Guard-Broken enemies by 7%.

Once hunters, they have now become monsters themselves. Using the terrain to their advantage, they slaughtered every righteous fighter who came to eliminate them. Their unchecked brutality only drew more hunters... and more bloodshed.

entries.name: Focus Pill
entries.desc:
Originally developed by the Mandate to calm restless Sha-Chi. Though it failed in its original purpose, it found another use: exciting one's fighting spirit and maintaining their strength and focus.

Reduces Sha-Chi consumption by 30% for 15 seconds and gradually restores 30% HP over the same duration.

entries.name: Sanguine Reach
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
A two-handed long blade crafted by Forge from the same materials as Sanguine. Designed for wide, sweeping strikes, it cuts through crowds with overwhelming force.

A long-bladed replica of Sanguine crafted by Forge for two-handed use.

entries.name: Sanguine Twin
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
A pair of short-handled twin blades crafted by Forge from the same material as Sanguine. Their attacks fall like rain, unmatched in speed.

A pair of short Sanguine blades forged for Soul by artisans under Inanis' command.

entries.name: Lingran's Pendant
entries.desc:
Reduces Sha-Chi consumption from Sha-Chi Combos by 15%.

"A gentleman does not part with his jade without cause." Clad in robes white as snow, Qingfeng was a man of extraordinary bearing, praised throughout the land as a hero of righteousness and honor. Whether those tales were true... ask the pile of bones beneath the cliff.

entries.name: Ancient Armor Fragment
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
The higher your HP, the greater the damage reduction, up to 20% at full HP.

A fragment of an ancient general's battle armor, buried for ages beneath the Sha-Chi Tower in Weeping Creek Valley. Yet the will that refused to lie buried still lingers within it.

entries.name: Scarlet Wraithblade
entries.desc:
A grotesque face grins from the hilt. This weapon has high Shield-Breaking power and can spread Red Spider Lilies across the ground, draining enemies' Sha-Chi and HP.

A massive dismembering blade once wielded by the bride, Hua.

entries.name: Jagged Steel
entries.desc:
A battered, rust-scarred blade with a jagged edge. Its slashes inflict Bleeding and can trigger Blood Loss.

A battered blade once wielded by Jagged Steel, a marauder as foolish as he was arrogant.

entries.name: Sanguine Reach
entries.desc:

A long-bladed replica of Sanguine crafted by Forge for two-handed use.

entries.name: Sanguine Twin
entries.desc:
A pair of short-handled twin blades crafted by Forge from the same material as Sanguine. Their attacks fall like rain, unmatched in speed.

A pair of short Sanguine blades forged for Soul by artisans under Inanis' command.

entries.name: Hunter's Chain Sickle
entries.desc:
Coiling, pulling, reaping. As precise as an extension of its master's arm. It strikes from mid- to long-range and can grapple onto distant anchor points for traversal.

A pair of chained sickles once wielded by the Hunt.

entries.name: Dread Axe
entries.desc:
A massive, weighty axe capable of splitting mountains and cleaving through armor in a single blow. It has high Shield-Breaking power.

A thick-bladed great axe once wielded by the Axemaster, Peng Meng.

entries.name: Feather Bow
entries.desc:
A powerful bow repaired and restrung by the old archer. A formidable weapon at range.

A powerful bow repaired and restrung by the old archer.

entries.name: Boulderguard
entries.desc:
Reduces damage taken by 15% while not Guard-Broken.

The Four Axes were four brothers who wandered the Wulin, never coveting fine robes, famed blades, or treasured artifacts. They lived by a code of righteousness, believing that as long as they walked an upright path, they had nothing to fear from blades lurking in the shadows. Yet the sharpest blade seldom cuts flesh. It strikes at the heart.

entries.name: Medicine Case
entries.desc:
Increases healing from Medicine by 20%.

When the young girl's sachet was refused, she followed the method her late mother had taught her to craft this medicine case. "Since it's for medicine, surely it won't be refused this time..." she thought, tucking a prayer for his safety inside as well.

entries.name: Battle Wraps
entries.desc:
Increases damage dealt to enemies by 5%.

The monsters that guard the silk have long since lost their sanity, but these specialized wraps allow them to channel their frenzy into controlled aggression.

entries.name: Shenji's Ring
entries.desc:
Holdingto block attacks reduces Sha-Chi consumption by 20%.

Crafted by dismantling and recombining over a hundred precision mechanisms from the Sha-Chi Tower, this ring offers a glimpse of the Shenji School's peerless craftsmanship. Its intricate mechanisms lock into place while blocking, drawing scattered Sha-Chi together into solid force.

entries.name: Hunter's Insight
entries.desc:
Increases damage dealt and Sha-Chi depletion against attacking enemies by 7%

A bronze pendant housing a crystal chip of unknown origin, capable of revealing the openings in an enemy's attacks. A swordsman once roamed the Wulin with it at his side. Striking only after his opponents made their move, he slew countless enemies. Then one day, he encountered a band of Maskwalkers.

Cave Prison Key
entries.desc:
A tarnished brass key, with old mine dust remaining in its grooves.

Long ago, disciples of the Mandate built these cells to confine their own who had undergone Transcension. Now, the cave has fallen into the hands of bandits, imprisoning captured righteous path fighters in these cells.

entries.name: Red Serpent Tongue
entries.desc:
A mechanical serpent's tongue. Cold, lifelike, and exquisitely crafted. The mechanism at its base seems made to fit a hidden keyhole.
 
This token was carefully placed within the Red Serpent Manor. What secret might it unlock?

entries.name: Loong Emblem (yin)
entries.desc:
A Loong with its head bowed, its finely detailed scales almost lifelike. Its eyes, inlaid with black jade, glow faintly in the darkness.

A smooth, rounded notch along its left edge appears to fit together with another fragment.

entries.name: Crimson Forest Tunnel Crank
entries.desc: A crank found beside the Butcher's chopping block. Perhaps it opens another grisly underground passage.

entries.name: Crimson Forest Secret Chamber Crank
entries.desc:
An iron crank clenched tightly in the hand of a Baishan disciple. It appears to open a secret door somewhere.

Taken from her stiff, pale hand, the crank still holds some warmth.

entries.name: Thieves' Camp Dungeon Key
entries.desc: A crude iron key with crooked teeth. It should be just enough to open a prison cell door.

entries.name: Crimson Forest Sha-chi Tower Key
entries.desc:
A key reforged from the remnants of broken parts. Its teeth are strangely pitted as though eaten away by corrosion.

Opens the door to the top level of the Crimson Forest Sha-Chi Tower.

entries.name: Forest Outpost Courtyard Key
entries.desc: Smoke once curled from the chimneys of this Outpost, children's laughter mingled with the sound of hoofbeats, and the innkeeper would wait by the door to welcome travelers from near and far. Back then, this key hung at her waist.

entries.name: Crimson Forest Cellar Crank
entries.desc:
A tiger-headed crank found on the second floor of a mountain cabin in the Crimson Forest. Traces of toxic gas still linger in its socket.

Corpses lie strewn about, while mournful cries never cease... What secrets lie in the cellar beneath the ruined cabin?

entries.name: Simmering Brew
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
The brewing flask of Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic. Its contents simmer gently, enriching its aroma and smoothness. Drinking it fills the body with the spirit of alcohol and gives rise to Sha-Chi.

Continuously generates Sha-Chi for 15 seconds and gradually restores 30% HP over the same duration.

entries.name: Shieldbreaker Talisman
entries.desc:
Increases damage dealt to Shield Durability by 50% and reduces damage taken from Spiked Shields by 30%.

A talisman bestowed by a general upon his men. Shaped like a shield and heavy as iron, it is plain and unadorned, scarred with countless dents. Yet beneath its rough exterior lies a stubborn spirit that would sooner break than bend.

entries.name: Brass Chest Guard
entries.desc:
Reduces Sha-Chi drain rate by 30% while holding  to maintain Guard Stance.

Layers of precision-forged brass plates overlap like scales. Upon impact, the spring-loaded mechanisms interlock to form a protective barrier.

"To Zhuo Bi, the most loyal and courageous among those under my command." — Wu Xuan

entries.name: Preservation Talisman Fragment I
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
The upper half of a talisman cleanly severed by a sharp blade. Grease and blood still stain the cut edge.

Its former owner appears to have been a greedy merchant, always using cheap tricks to deceive his customers. The butcher merely gave him what he deserved.

entries.name: Preservation Talisman Fragment II
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
The lower half of the talisman. Its clean break bears witness to the swift, decisive stroke that severed it.

When reunited with its upper half, it reduces poison damage.

entries.name: Sect Leader's Snuff Bottle
entries.desc:
A snuff bottle hollowed from a single piece of golden amber, confiscated from a Mandate disciple by a sect leader. The sect leader often admonished his disciples "to renounce worldly desires and temptations", yet in private, he would amuse himself with objects like this.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Kuye Dew
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
A treasured remedy of Kuye Temple. Consuming it temporarily hardens the body like stone, fortifying it against blades. Ever since it found its way into the Wulin, Mandate disciples have fought over it, even drawing blades on one another.

Originally developed by the Mandate to calm restless Sha-Chi. Though it failed in its original purpose, it found another use: exciting one's fighting spirit and maintaining their…

entries.name: Bloodstained Seal
entries.desc:
A square seal carved from Shoushan stone, the token of a sect master. One corner is stained with blood, the deep crimson seeping into the stone. No one can say whether the blood was shed by the one who sought to seize the seal or by the one who fought to protect it.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Ancient Crossbow
entries.desc:
A crossbow mechanism cast from fine bronze, its components fitted together with remarkable precision for a smooth, accurate release. Today, it is regarded as the pinnacle of ancient Engine Arts and eagerly sought after as a symbol of refined taste and appreciation for ancient craftsmanship. Few realize that long ago, it was merely one of countless ordinary crossbow mechanisms.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded…

entries.name: Miracle Remedy
entries.desc:
A researcher whose conscience had not yet been extinguished secretly brewed this medicine and hid it within the Sha-Chi Tower, hoping to give those poor souls nearing their end one last chance to survive.

Restores 30% HP. Restores an additional 30% HP when HP is below 35%.

entries.name: Chaos Ring
entries.desc:
Chaos Flame inflicts Sha-Chi Burn on enemies and restores 50% of the Sha-Chi they lose.

The sinister flame within Chaos, the Third Master, had always been difficult to control, burning countless things to ash. Yet she carefully kept this ring, a gift from her senior sister, and never once wore it.

entries.name: Cavalrybane
entries.desc:
Increases damage dealt to mounted enemies by 25%.

A relic left behind by a Mandate hero who met his end standing firm against a cavalry charge. The lingering Sha-Chi within still makes warhorses whinny in terror and refuse to advance.

entries.name: Frostward
entries.desc:
Reduces Chill effects by 50% and reduces Freeze duration by 50%.

An ingeniously crafted fire striker with a flint core concealed within. A simple pull of the ring ignites a flame, enough to ward off the cold even on frozen tundra.

entries.name: The Fanatic's Broken Blade
entries.desc:
A broken sword. Drinking awakens its power, allowing it to fly through the air and strike distant enemies. Damage falls off over distance.

The broken sword of Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic, with three feet of blade still remaining.

entries.name: Outlaw Warblade
entries.desc:
A ruthless, blood-drinking warblade with high Shield-Breaking power. It can drain enemy blood to restore HP, or consume own HP to cut enemies down.

A warblade once wielded by Jing Ye, the Outlaw.

entries.name: Freezing Chaos
entries.desc:
Honed to sever all things, the blade rises with bone-chilling frost and falls with black flame that scorches the heavens.

An enigmatic blade once wielded by Twisted Puppet No. 34, Yucong.

entries.name: White Serpent & Crimson Viper
entries.desc:
A nimble, graceful short blade paired with a sinuous, powerful long blade. Together, they dance like twin serpents, shifting through endless variations.

A pair of serpentine blades once belonging to Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents.

entries.name: Flying Dagger
entries.desc:
Its shimmering blade is as thin as a cicada's wing. Once thrown, it never misses its mark.

An exquisite willow-leaf throwing dagger acquired from Quick Hand Zhang.

entries.name: Iron Gauntlets
entries.desc:
A pair of heavy, unadorned iron gauntlets. Their spikes and striking plates have been polished bright through countless battles. They have high Shield-Breaking power and build Fist Focus, making each attack more powerful.

Iron gauntlets obtained from Iron Fever.

entries.name: Silent Wrap
entries.desc:
Reduces noise from footsteps and Assassinations by 50%.

An old wrap, its edges worn pale with age. It once belonged to a thief who used it to vault over high walls and dart across rooftops. Yet on lonely nights, he would linger, watching the lights of a distant home, unable to bring himself to leave.

entries.name: Quick Hand Pendant
entries.desc:
Increases One-Handed weapon damage by 10%.

Quick Hand Zhang chuckled and opened his palm, revealing a pendant. "With this, you can wield your sword in one hand and leave the other free. Whether you use that free hand to save a life or retrieve what you need is entirely up to you."

entries.name: Calming Gourd
entries.desc:
Use Medicine to recover from the Guard-Broken state and prevent Sha-Chi consumption for 3 seconds.

A small, finely crafted seven-holed gourd. Before retiring from a life of theft, Thief Wang entrusted it to Yu'er. She carefully infused it with calming herbs, giving it the remarkable ability to steady the mind and restore composure.

entries.name: Seal Of Dugu
entries.desc:
Increases the Sha-Chi depletion of Sha-Chi Combos by 8%.

Dugu Linghe left behind this seal, along with a mountainside strewn with bones. The Baishan Sect slaughtered her family. She answered by bathing Baishan in blood.

Years later, Bi Taotao enshrined the seal in a small shrine dedicated to Dugu Linghe. It remained there until Perfect Transcension spread throughout Baishan. Then Ju, a disciple of the Baishan…

entries.name: Preservation Jar
entries.desc:
Reduces poison damage taken by 50%.

Food stored within this jar remains fresh, making it a favorite among butchers.

If placed amid heaps of rot and filth, it might produce a curious effect.

A talisman crafted from an ivory pick, woven with instrument strings and strands of hair. Despite the passage of time, both remain as supple as ever. The strings were taken from the pipa once played by Inanis, while the hair belonged to her beloved daughter. "May my daughter live a lifetime of peace and happiness."

Puppet No. 44's Eye
entries.desc: The passage deep within the Smuggler's Tunnel is blocked by Puppet No.44. This eye is the key to the puppet lock.

entries.name: Old Man Gen's Brass Key
entries.desc: An old key passed down through generations, older even than Old Man Gen himself.

entries.name: Village Of Lu Cellar Key
entries.desc:
A key pieced together from several iron bars. Besides opening the hidden entrance to the Smuggler's Tunnel, it seems to have served its owner just as often for picking locks.

The character for "Lu" is engraved on one end, it may be the cellar key to an old house in Village of Lu.

entries.name: Village Of Lu Cellar Key
entries.desc:
A key pieced together from several iron bars. Besides opening the hidden entrance to the Smuggler's Tunnel, it seems to have served its owner just as often for picking locks.

The character for "Lu" is engraved on one end, it may be the cellar key to an old house in Village of Lu.

entries.name: Tunnel Cage Key
entries.desc:
A key fashioned from a puppet's finger. Three smaller fingers jut unnaturally from the knuckles, together forming the key's teeth.

Villagers were not the only captives here. The Herald's subordinates also caged thieves from the Smuggler's Tunnel, all destined for the making of puppets.

entries.name: Loong Emblem (yang)
entries.desc:
A Loong with its head raised toward the heavens, its whiskers flowing gracefully. Its eyes, inlaid with agate, gleam as though alive.

A smooth, rounded notch along its right edge appears to fit together with another fragment.

entries.name: Black Serpent Fang
entries.desc:
A serpent's fang finely carved from crystal, smooth as a mirror and sharp as a blade. The slightest carelessness could see it pierce anyone seeking its secrets.

Yet there are always those willing to brave this risk, if only to glimpse the truth beyond the door.

entries.name: Remnant Spark Cage
entries.desc:
Triggering a Phantom Edge follow-up attack has a 33% chance to restore 1  Remnant Spark.

In his younger days, Uncle Lu traveled far and wide as an armed escort. He took this little cage from an ancient tomb, calling it an evil-warding relic. Why else would he insist it was for keeping crickets when no one had ever seen him raise a single one? And why does an eerie light always seem to stir within it?

entries.name: Livingwood Talisman
entries.desc:
Bleed and life-draining effects are 50% effective against Puppets and Golden Bodies.

A wooden talisman covered in bulbous growths, carved from an ancient tree that grew upon a battlefield littered with corpses. Though it is dead wood, legend says it still bleeds.

entries.name: A Puppet's Wooden Heart
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Increases summon duration by 25%.

A wooden heart that fell from the shattered bodies of two embracing puppets. In life, the divide between yin and yang kept them apart, leaving them to search for each other in vain. Only after becoming puppets could they finally reunite and embrace at the place where they made their vows.

entries.name: White Jade Twins
entries.desc:
A pendant intricately carved from fine white jade, depicting two cheerful children at play among lush lotus leaves, a traditional blessing for many generations of children. Passed down through the Lu family for generations, it ultimately came into the hands of a man who lived and died alone, without a wife or children.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Spirit-Returning Broth
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Guided by Dusk, some villagers of Village of Lu tried to create a formula that could awaken their sleeping loved ones. But ordinary medicine was powerless against such a strange affliction. In desperation, the villagers placed the medicine before a shrine to the Lady, praying for divine intervention.

Increases Guard Break by 10% for 30 seconds and restores 20% HP.

entries.name: Jewel's Knot
entries.desc:
Increases HP by 15%.

The colored threads were prepared by Second Sister Myst, the metal loops were crafted by Eldest Sister Forge, and the knots were Jewel's proudest handiwork. One of a kind though it was, Forge found it cumbersome, Myst thought it too fussy, and Jewel had no desire to keep it for herself. After giving it some thought, they decided to give it to Master Soul.

entries.name: Unveiled Statue
entries.desc:
A seated Bodhisattva carved from a single piece of huanghuali wood, serene in posture with a compassionate gaze. The Lu Villagers have covered the faces of every other statue with red flowers, worshipping them as the "Lady of the Veil." This one alone remains uncovered, bearing silent witness to an act of resistance.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Forbidden Concoction
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
A secret tonic passed among assassins who lurk in the depths of the Discordance. Brewed from the Sha-Chi of the dead and unstable remnants of Phantom Arts, it rapidly heals injuries while allowing the user to forcibly draw power from the Discordance itself.

Increases Phantom Edge damage by 10% for 15 seconds and restores 20% HP.

entries.name: Wedding Candles
entries.desc:
A pair of wedding candles finely crafted from multicolored beeswax, seemingly waiting all these years for that wedding feast. The two magpies dancing across the candles remain as vibrant as ever. Yet at the corner of one magpie's eye rests a single waxen tear, formed at some unknown time and frozen in place before it could fall.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Fiend Saws
entries.desc:
A pair of unique blades once wielded by Jade Dancer with her legs. Soul now wields them by hand, but their deep-seated Fiend-Aura remains undiminished.

A pair of curved, serrated blades modeled after Jade Dancer's leg blades.

entries.name: Wild Oriole Sword
entries.desc:
The Young Mistress's keen, lightning-quick blade. Though light in hand, it fills the air with a dazzling flurry of strikes.

A light, slender sword received from Mu Xiaokui.

entries.name: Tianxuan Bronze Sword
entries.desc:
A bronze sword, masterful in its simplicity. It offers high Shield-Breaking power when attacking and rock-solid defense when blocking.

An ancient bronze sword once wielded by Bi Yuan, leader of the Tianxuan Sect.

entries.name: Kuye Temple Prayer Beads
entries.desc:
An ancient string of prayer beads left behind by Master Bi Hai of Kuye Temple. Unadorned, yet bearing the weight of countless years. When invoked, it summons the long-departed disciples of Kuye Temple to fight by your side.

An ancient prayer bead strand once owned by Master Bi Hai of Kuye Temple.

entries.name: Heartrend Pipa
entries.desc:
A replica pipa with a clear, mournful tone that rends the heart. Its music can release Sonic Blades sharp enough to cut through anything.

An exquisite pipa once wielded by Musician Puppet Yuzan.

entries.name: Puppeteer's Bell
entries.desc:
The Puppeteer's bell rings with a clear, ethereal chime. Each ring commands all manner of Puppets.

An old ritual bell left behind by the Puppeteer, Dusk.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.desc:
Gatekeeper Zhuo Bi's shield can withstand any attack, absorbing incoming damage and channeling it into a powerful counterattack.

The massive shield once wielded by Gatekeeper Zhuo Bi.

entries.name: Mother's Talisman
entries.desc:
Restores 10% HP when Guard-Broken.

The villagers spoke of a madwoman who cradled a wooden stump as if it were her baby, humming lullabies as she nursed it. But after those little creaking things appeared, no one dared speak of her again.

entries.name: Fine Thread
entries.desc:
Increases the damage and Sha-Chi depletion caused by summon objects by 50%.

A bundle of fine thread spun from silk and silver thread. In ordinary hands, it's little more than thread for mending clothes. But in the hands of a master, it can pluck a pearl from a table ten paces away without anyone ever noticing.

entries.name: Arrowward
entries.desc:
Reduces ranged damage and Sha-Chi depletion taken by 20%.

The former owner of this talisman was no great hero, just a thief scraping out a living by scaling walls and breaking into homes. Yet whenever a hidden arrow came for his throat, he would somehow slip half an inch to the side.

entries.name: Agarwood Prayer Beads
entries.desc:
Reduces recovery time from Guard-Broken by 15%.

These prayer beads were blessed by the monks of Kuye Temple. When rolled between the fingers, the gentle scent of agarwood slowly drifts forth, while distant Buddhist chants seem to echo in the ear. The monks' long-held wish remains unfulfilled, yet their resolve to guide others endures within the beads, now resting in the hands of the next traveler.

entries.name: Remnant Spark Cage
entries.desc:
Triggering a Phantom Edge follow-up attack has a 33% chance to restore 1  Remnant Spark.

In his younger days, Uncle Lu traveled far and wide as an armed escort. He took this little cage from an ancient tomb, calling it an evil-warding relic. Why else would he insist it was for keeping crickets when no one had ever seen him raise a single one? And why does an eerie light always seem to stir within it?

entries.name: Livingwood Talisman
entries.desc:
Bleed and life-draining effects are 50% effective against Puppets and Golden Bodies.

A wooden talisman covered in bulbous growths, carved from an ancient tree that grew upon a battlefield littered with corpses. Though it is dead wood, legend says it still bleeds.

entries.name: A Puppet's Wooden Heart
entries.desc:
Increases summon duration by 25%.

A wooden heart that fell from the shattered bodies of two embracing puppets. In life, the divide between yin and yang kept them apart, leaving them to search for each other in vain. Only after becoming puppets could they finally reunite and embrace at the place where they made their vows.

entries.name: Jewel's Knot
entries.desc:
Increases HP by 15%.

The colored threads were prepared by Second Sister Myst, the metal loops were crafted by Eldest Sister Forge, and the knots were Jewel's proudest handiwork. One of a kind though it was, Forge found it cumbersome, Myst thought it too fussy, and Jewel had no desire to keep it for herself. After giving it some thought, they decided to give it to Master Soul.

entries.name: Spirit-Returning Broth
entries.desc:
Guided by Dusk, some villagers of Village of Lu tried to create a formula that could awaken their sleeping loved ones. But ordinary medicine was powerless against such a strange affliction. In desperation, the villagers placed the medicine before a shrine to the Lady, praying for divine intervention.

Increases Guard Break by 10% for 30 seconds and restores 20% HP.

Increases Phantom Edge damage by 10% for 15 seconds and restores 20% HP.

Opera Ticket
entries.desc:
Tickets to performances at the Mirage Estate have always been hard to come by, and the competition for them has only grown fiercer. The Thread-Binders fight over a single ticket, spilling blood for the chance to attend.

Only with this ticket may one enter the Opera Theater.

entries.name: Opera Ticket
entries.desc:
Tickets to performances at the Mirage Estate have always been hard to come by, and the competition for them has only grown fiercer. The Thread-Binders fight over a single ticket, spilling blood for the chance to attend.

Only with this ticket may one enter the Opera Theater.

entries.name: Golden Cloud-moon Hairpin
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Cloud motifs curl around the fine jade set into the hairpin, like drifting clouds cradling the moon. Long ago, during a grand performance banquet at The Mirage Estate, an entertainer used Phantom Arts to bring the clouds and moon depicted on the hairpin to life upon the stage. The guests could no longer tell where illusion ended and reality began.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for…

entries.name: General's Bronze Mirror
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
An ancient bronze mirror inlaid with turquoise. Legend has it that a general of old once used it to expose evil forces. The damaged base is scorched and mottled, as though eaten away by some lingering corruption.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Nuo Mask Fragment: Joy
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: Three thousand guests feast behind vermilion gates, hosts and guests alike wearing smiling masks. When the feast ends, they unmask in search of old friends, only to find they've forgotten their own true faces.

entries.name: Gold-and-silver Sachet
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: A sachet layered with overlapping gold and silver ornaments. Patron Yao had it specially commissioned as a gift for a celebrated acrobat. As the performer danced high above on the tightrope, the sachet at their waist shimmered like a Loong in motion, its golden and silver scales chiming softly with each step. By the end of the performance, the entire hall was filled with its fragrance. And Patron Yao would always…

entries.name: Nuo Mask Fragment: Sorrow
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: Three stacks of paper offerings weep in the wind; a lone lamp shines upon the desolation. Forever mourning the lives and deaths of others, one looks back only to find one's own bereavement forgotten.

entries.name: Nuo Mask Fragment: Wrath
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: From the high platform, cries of rebuke thunder without cease; crimson jaws and bared fangs howl through the endless night. Who knew that the fire raised to purge evil would first scorch the heart that kindled it?

entries.name: Feather Fan Plume
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Increases Ice, Fire, and Lightning damage dealt to enemies by 20%.

Once a treasured ornament held in the hands of a renowned performer, it dazzled audiences with spectacles of ice, flame, and thunder.

entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Before every performance, wine was poured in offering: first to pray for blessings from gods and spirits, then for the peace and well-being of the audience. But ever since the Estate changed hands, the ritualists have never removed their Nuo Masks, and the spirits within have grown ever more rampant with each exorcism.

Increases Burn, Paralysis, Freeze, and Bleed buildup rate by 50% for 15 seconds and restores 20%…

entries.name: Executioner's Headscarf
entries.desc:
Executing an enemy reduces main weapon switch cooldown by 1 second.

Long-time executioners know that a headscarf ought to be kept pitch-black. Otherwise, matters best left unspoken at a New Year's feast would lie exposed, like the old stains on this hanging curtain.

entries.name: Crescent Blade
entries.desc:
A crescent blade is carved with the image of Qinglong. With sweeping cuts and cleaving strikes, it can break through anything.

A long crescent blade once wielded by Yuding, No.12, Crescent Blade Puppet.

entries.name: Tiger Cannon
entries.desc:
A powerful cannon whose thunderous blast echoes like a tiger's roar. Lei Dang's final gift to an old friend.

A signature cannon once wielded by Lei Dang, the Order's Envoy.

entries.name: Wraith Mask
entries.desc:
Triggering “Ghoststep” with a Parry or Perfect Dodge creates 3 Wraith Masks that automatically attack nearby enemies.

Some donned this mask simply to survive. But in time, it fused with flesh and blood, and could no longer be removed... It was as though the mask itself had learned fear, learned to survive, and grown more possessive of that body than any living soul could be.

entries.name: Nuo Mask
entries.desc:
Reduces the  Remnant Spark cost of Summon-type Phantom Edges by 1. Summons gain Berserk, slightly increasing their damage while active.

Neither weeping nor smiling, this ghostly mask always fits perfectly, as though it were flesh grown from the wearer's own face. A person wears a hundred faces, each born of the heart... or is the heart born of the face?

entries.name: Thundermoon Lantern
entries.desc:
Inflicting a Thunderstrike Effect on an enemy automatically triggers Lightning Strikes on enemies within a certain radius.

As the lantern dims, splendor fades; as thunder rises, slaughter follows. This lantern has long ceased to shine for the stage. Instead, it draws lightning and wildfire from all directions, illuminating the ruins of a shattered dream. Yet the lantern itself has never changed; only its bearer has.

Old Man Gen's Brass Key
entries.desc: An old key passed down through generations, older even than Old Man Gen himself.

entries.name: Heavy Lion Hall Gate Key
entries.desc:
A silver key shaped like a lion dance ball. It opens the main gate to the Lion Dance Hall.

When sunlight passes through its openwork, it casts the silhouette of a lion with a ball in its jaws. Its weight seems to hold the echo of drums and gongs from days past.

entries.name: Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key
entries.desc:
A roughly forged iron spare key. The plain, rigid design suggests it was made in haste.

Opens the outer gate of the mountain road leading to the Mandate's encampment.

entries.name: Backstreet Cellar Crank
entries.desc:
A rough metal crank with red cloth wrapped tightly around its handle, probably to keep it from slipping.

Opens the hidden cellar in the backstreets.

entries.name: Auspicious Lion Fireball
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Increases Fire damage dealt to enemies by 20%. Ignite inflicted by attacks spreads to nearby enemies.

Our ancestors taught: "So long as the flame burns, the lion's spirit lives on." Burning with an undying flame, this embroidered ball has lit the way for generations amid the thunder of drums and gongs.

entries.name: Thunderward
entries.desc:
Reduces Lightning damage taken by 50% and Paralysis buildup rate by 50%.

Long ago, a smith was forging iron on a stormy night when a bolt of lightning struck the ingot. It split but did not break apart. Since then, its bearers have stood untouched by even the fiercest storms.

entries.name: Formless Divine Mirror
entries.desc:
Any  attack that hits an enemy builds temporary  Remnant Spark. Ranged-type Phantom Edges consume temporary  Remnant Spark first.

"The Formless Mirror sees through illusion. Spares you the effort, but dulls your edge... Worth it or not? That's for you to decide, youngster!"

entries.name: Carved-edge Inkstone
entries.desc:
The craftsman carving this inkstone fell ill, spending ever longer asleep and ever less time awake, until one day he never woke again, his carving knife still clenched in hand. The unfinished inkstone was placed in storage by the healers. But ever since, they have occasionally come across a Wooden Puppet inside, quietly carving an inkstone, one stroke at a time.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand…

entries.name: Ink Stick
entries.desc:
A medicinal ink stick shaped like a cicada shell. Years ago, a local landowner presented it to General Wu Xuan and his men in gratitude for their defense against the Maskwalkers. But this medicine could do little to mend so many broken bodies. How could it compare to the immediate effects of Perfect Transcension?

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Congeal talisman
entries.desc:
Reduces Soul's chance of Bleeding and Bleed Gauge buildup rate by 50%.

To avoid stirring old disputes, healers refrain from speaking the name of the woman who created this talisman. Yet they all remember her: a healer who devoted her life to the study of rare and difficult ailments, always accompanied by a child at her side. Three years ago, she passed from this world, leaving behind only a medical journal filled…

entries.name: Thunder Spear
entries.desc:
A long spear that rose to fame alongside Chang Hong, one of the Order's Envoys. It draws lightning from all directions, channeling it into thunderous force.

A keen spear once wielded by Chang Hong, wreathed in crackling lightning.

entries.name: You Loong's Deluge
entries.desc:
A Loong-headed weapon forged by You Loong, leader of the Blackwater Crew. It unleashes the power of rivers and seas, making it especially effective against enemies wielding Fire weapons.

A Loong-headed weapon that sprays water, forged by You Loong, leader of the Blackwater Crew.

entries.name: Goldblaze
entries.desc:
A firelock crafted from pure gold. Beyond seven paces, this weapon is faster.

A pure-gold firelock obtained from Quick Hand Zhang.

entries.name: Wolfjaw
entries.desc:
A fallen general's spiked mace, forged for the battlefield. Swung like a blood-crazed wolf, it drains life from enemies on hit.

A spiked mace once wielded by Fallen General Wu Xuan.

entries.name: Blessed Jade Pendant
entries.desc:
After using Medicine, randomly gain one of the following effects:
1. Inflicts Burning on yourself and nearby enemies.
2. Inflicts Poison on yourself and nearby enemies.
3. Conjures a Chaos fireball that automatically attacks nearby enemies.
4. Immediately restores all HP and 50% Sha-Chi.

A simple jade pendant. Though the jade itself is not of the finest quality, it bears a smooth, lustrous sheen, as though imbued…

entries.name: Snow and Blood
entries.desc:
When a nearby enemy is Bleeding, damage dealt to enemies increases by 10%. Enemies also take 20% more Bleeding damage while attacking.

A token exchanged between two young lovers as a pledge of devotion. Red as congealed blood and white as frost and snow, the coral beads intertwine in alternating hues, reflecting their shared hope of weathering every storm together and never parting.

entries.name: Everflow
entries.desc:
Following the natural cycle of growth and decay, Xie Qiudong brewed this medicine from maple leaves in the fall. On use, the brew gathers the lingering Sha-Chi of the dead and condenses it back into liquid, ensuring that it never truly runs dry.

Restores 20% HP. When no uses remain, defeating any enemy restores 1 use.

entries.name: Merciful Dew
entries.desc:
The year the young man joined the Mandate, his mother spent the last of her dowry to obtain a medicinal formula blessed by the Lady. Every year thereafter, she sent him medicinal dew prepared by her own hand.

Restores 60% HP over 10 seconds.

entries.name: Green Serpent Brew
entries.desc:
Years ago, Xie Huichun devoted half his life to finding a way to reverse Transcension. His unfinished formula eventually found its way to the Green Serpent House, where it underwent numerous revisions before becoming the remedy it is today.

Removes all status effects, increases status resistance by 75% for 15 seconds, and gradually restores 20% HP over the same duration.

Tianxiang Pavilion Key
entries.desc:
An engraved key carrying a faint scent of rouge and powder.

Opens the main gate to Tianxiang Pavilion.

entries.name: Pavilion of Knowledge Rooftop Key
entries.desc:
A key to the uppermost level of the Pavilion of Knowledge. The teeth are cast in the shape of the Qian trigram: three unbroken yang lines, strong and solemn.

Heaven follows its constant course, while the world's secrets gather within this pavilion.

entries.name: Lan Manor Key
entries.desc:
An ornate bronze key engraved with delicate orchid motifs. Though it appears to have been passed down for a century, its luster remains undimmed.

With this key, perhaps there will be a chance to rescue the children inside the Lan Manor.

entries.name: Huang Manor Key
entries.desc: Key to the front gate of the Huang Manor, adorned with a gold auspicious cloud charm. It appears to be worth a fair sum.

entries.name: Jade Brush Rest
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
A blue-green jade brush carved with auspicious cloud motifs, paired with a mountain-shaped jade brush rest. Years ago, a wealthy patron acquired the set from an impoverished scholar who had placed first in the imperial examinations. No one remembers what became of the scholar. The jade brush, meanwhile, has spent its days lying on the young master's desk, never again putting a single elegant line to paper.

A…

entries.name: Tiger Paperweight
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
A reclining tiger paperweight cast from solid gold and finished in festive vermilion lacquer. It was once a lavish gift from a sect leader surnamed Ming to a painter at Tianxiang Pavilion. But in times of chaos, fortunes can turn overnight: one day, it was an enviable treasure holding down a sheet of paper; the next, a deadly burden weighing on its owner's heart.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand…

entries.name: Medicine Pot Fragment: Body
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: Her fate was much like this medicine pot: suspended by iron chains over the fire, never to be freed.

entries.name: Medicine Pot Fragment: Lid
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: The lid of a medicine pot fired from coarse clay, shaped like a knotted root and rough to the touch.

entries.name: Medicine Pot Fragment: Handle
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: A broken, root-shaped handle from a medicine pot, permeated with the bitter scent of medicinal herbs.

entries.name: Medicine Pot Fragment: Chain
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: An almost intact iron chain used to suspend the pot over a fire.

entries.name: Treasure
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile

entries.name: Flameward
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Reduces fire damage by 50% and Burn buildup rate by 50%.

A protective charm forged from rare azurite, its brilliant blue reminiscent of lake and sky. Ash and cinders dare not settle upon it, and even flames shrink back at its approach. It is best worn at the waist by those who must walk through fire.

entries.name: Parting Hooks
entries.desc:
The hooks trace arcs like waning moons. They can assume a Guard Stance to turn defense into offense and have high shield-breaking power.

A pair of silver hooks once wielded by Soulclaimer, Elite Shadow Warden.

entries.name: Armybreaker
entries.desc:
A broad-bladed polearm built to break enemy formations. It has high shield-breaking power and can rush into enemies.

A long, heavy blade once wielded by Cavalrybane, Elite Shadow Warden.

entries.name: Blaze
entries.desc:
Twin meteor hammers packed with highly combustible phosphor powder. Once unleashed, they streak through the air like blazing meteors, turning the battlefield into an inferno.

A blazing chain hammer once wielded by Blaze, leader of the Shadow Wardens.

entries.name: Flaming Mane
entries.desc:
The Lion Dance Grandmaster's signature lion-head weapon, capable of breathing roaring flames that strike fear into enemies.

The signature lion head weapon of Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster.

entries.name: Ultimate Talisman
entries.desc:
Power Surge deals 20% more damage to Guard Broken enemies.

A withered lotus bears no seeds, yet longing may condense into pearls. The scholar knew nothing of martial arts, but he understood her. She accepted this talisman, and from then on, amid the storms of the Wulin, she had someone to hold dear.

entries.name: Crimson Resolve
entries.desc:
Landing more than 2 consecutive hits within 1 second increases damage dealt to enemies by 15% for 2 seconds. 5-second cooldown.

Some surely thought him a fool. To trade for food, water, and the lives of a group of children, he gave up his fortune, made countless enemies, and even pawned his family's jade thumb ring to someone of the Wulin. Yet Lan Shaodi felt nothing but a clear conscience and quiet satisfaction.

entries.name: Manor Medicine Pot
entries.desc:
Using Medicine has a 8% chance not to consume a use.

Wealthy Merchant Huang's second wife, Fourth Madam, said that this fine medicine pot was unmatched for drawing out the potency of medicinal herbs. Yet her daughter Xiu's illness showed no signs of improving.

entries.name: Remnant Spark Cube
entries.desc:
Increases the damage of all Phantom Edges by 12%.

Restored to wholeness by Myst, this Remnant Spark Cube can no longer be returned to the vessel that once voyaged beyond the heavens. Even so, it remains more than capable of aiding in the control of Phantom Edges.

entries.name: Dance Fan
entries.desc:
Increases damage dealt based on the distance traveled during the attack, up to 40%.

Time and hardship have never shown mercy to leading opera actresses. All that remains is this dance fan. With every opening and closing, visions of flowing water sleeves and a hall filled with applause return, faint yet vivid.

entries.name: Sha-Chi Headscarf
entries.desc:
Increases Sha-Chi recovery rate by 15%.

A gift of thanks presented by the Child of Insight after the three renowned heroes' keepsakes were returned on Xue's behalf. Though the cloth is light, it still carries an undiminished edge.

entries.name: Flameward
entries.desc:
Reduces fire damage by 50% and Burn buildup rate by 50%.

A protective charm forged from rare azurite, its brilliant blue reminiscent of lake and sky. Ash and cinders dare not settle upon it, and even flames shrink back at its approach. It is best worn at the waist by those who must walk through fire.

entries.desc:
A slender, flat key with a round opening at one end for hooking onto the locking bar.

When Moji was here, the door to his residence was usually left unlocked. Those who came to seek instruction, pay a visit, or test their skills against him were always welcome. After his disappearance, his disciples kept the house tightly locked to protect their master's legacy from Huangxing's followers.

entries.name: Guardian Idol Fragment: Head
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: The head of the Guardian Idol, its eyes still wide with fury. It once witnessed its worshippers seek the Way through martial discipline, only to watch one of them raise a stone against it with trembling hands.

A medicine developed by the Order's Serpent House that somehow found its way into the Wulin. Sealed within the bottle are fragments of sorrowful memories.

entries.name: Guardian Idol Fragment: Arm
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: Members of the Mandate once laid a hand upon this arm to swear their oaths. Later, those very same hands shattered it.

entries.name: Phantom Remedy
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Everyone has a reflection of themselves within the Discordance. Years ago, a Serpent House healer from the Order combined Phantom Arts with medicine, creating a treatment capable of directly healing these reflections while generating exceptionally pure and powerful Sha-Chi.

Restores roughly 60% HP and Sha-Chi over 6 seconds. Taking a hit interrupts recovery.

entries.name: Nameless Thumb Ring
entries.desc:
IncreasesSha-Chi Essence buildup rate by 5%.

Some things are twisted and broken by overwhelming Sha-Chi, becoming instruments of evil. Others, however, are tempered by it, awakening a righteous spirit that neither ice nor time can wear away.

entries.name: Guardian Idol Fragment: Torso
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: The fractured edges of its broken form have long since been worn smooth. No one knows how many hands have picked it up, only to cast it aside again.

entries.name: Guardian Idol Fragment: Leg
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc: In the face of the endless terror wrought by the Maskwalkers, these legs never once gave ground. Yet in the end, even they could not support the people's collapsing resolve.

entries.name: Soft Snake Sword
entries.desc:
A flexible blade that moves with serpentine grace. It can deflect enemy attacks and grant its wielder the fluid agility of a serpent.

A soft, flexible sword once wielded by Wu Lengshuang.

entries.name: Baishan Stormswords
entries.desc:
The Baishan Sect's sacred treasure, capable of channeling the power of wind and thunder. When both forces converge...

A pair of swords once wielded by Bi Taotao, Master of the Baishan Sect.

entries.name: Bashpole
entries.desc:
A melon-shaped hammerhead, capable of shattering stone, cracking the earth, and crushing enemies with ground-shaking force. It has high shield-breaking power.

A long-handled heavy hammer once wielded by Wan Jun, the Coppermaul.

entries.name: Swordsman's Summon
entries.desc:
The Xia spirit of the righteous Mandate's disciples has never faded. At the sight of this token, they will answer the call with swords in hand.

A token once used by the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars to command the heroes of Wulin.

entries.name: Guardian Idol
entries.desc:
Destruction-type Phantom Edges consume 1 additionalRemnant Spark and deal 75% more damage.

This guardian idol was once carried and worshipped by members of the Mandate. As the shadow of Sha-Chi Transcension fell over the Wulin and the martial way fell into decline, those same worshippers smashed it with their own hands before turning to kneel before the statue of the Lady of the Veil.

entries.name: Twin Fish Pendant
entries.desc:
Damage increases as Sha-Chi decreases, up to 20%.

No matter how many hardships stand in the way, no matter how many dangers lie ahead... "Though the Wulin offers no path, this bond remains unbroken."

entries.name: Broken Vessel
entries.desc:
Sha-Chi Combos that consume Sha-Chi deal 15% more damage.

The ruined head of a puppet stands as a silent indictment of the Herald's countless crimes. On the training groungs, he performed the forbidden art of Soul Displacement, forcibly imprisoning the consciousness of countless Mandate disciples within Vessels.

Phantom Brew
entries.desc:
The illusionist who created this remedy was cast out by the Mandate. Uninterested in martial arts, he devoted himself to Esoteric Arts and medicine. From half an ancient manuscript, he learned that true Phantom Arts can blur illusion and reality, deceiving even the world around him.

Restores 50% HP and grants Intangible for 1 second. While Intangible, you cannot be hit by any attack.

entries.name: Sundial Of Impermanence
entries.desc:
No one knows whose work it was, but the missing sections of the sundial were repaired with inlaid crystal. It does not measure time. It divines fate. And seeing where fate leads is not always a blessing.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Blight Astrolabe
entries.desc:
Everyone who came into possession of this astrolabe believed it could reveal the movements of the Blight. Yet even after years of complex calculations, they remained consumed by their work, muttering cryptic words like madmen. Perhaps they really did find the answer, only to lose the ability to share it with the world.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Acolyte Icicle
entries.desc:
Increases the Chill Effect and its duration against enemies by 30%.

Forged from solid ice and Phantom Arts, it is not truly ice, yet radiates a bone-piercing cold. It resembles ice, yet never melts. How could such a marvel not tempt one to unravel its mysteries... and perhaps even touch upon the forbidden?

entries.name: Acolyte Whisk
entries.desc:
Inflicting Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Poison effects on enemies builds a small amount of Elemental Energy. When fully charged, restores 1 Remnant Spark.

With forbidden arts, every thread and strand comes at a price. The further something lies beyond the laws of nature, the greater the price it demands... This single thread may only be the beginning. To possess the complete whisk, far more must be sacrificed.

entries.name: Red-Cloth Door Key
entries.desc:
A key with a faded strip of red cloth tied to the end.

Be it a wedding, success in the examinations, or a reunion with an old friend far from home, a touch of festive red always adorns such celebrations.

entries.name: White Serpent Eye
entries.desc: An amber crystal shaped like the eye of a serpent. Within its translucent core is a naturally embedded dark band, shimmering and shifting with the angle of the light, as if the serpent's gaze were following your every move.

entries.name: Battleforged
entries.desc:
After 10 seconds without taking damage, becomes immune to the next hit.

A pale armlet carved from the bone of a resentful beast, long steeped in the suffering of countless battles. It can temper the body into steel or harden one into something inhuman. It all depends on its wearer: whether to remain true to one's convictions, or surrender to murderous intent.

entries.name: Blue Blossom Compass
entries.desc:
An exquisite compass case engraved with blue flowers. The compass within can point to good and evil, fortune and misfortune—even to what its bearer desires most. But rely on it too heavily at your peril. However precise the instrument, the human heart is never so easily read.

A priceless treasure. It can be traded to Quick Hand Zhang for useful items.

entries.name: Remnant Spark Cube Fragment: Mortise
entries.desc: A metal fragment with strangely angled folds. When held in hand, a distant hum seems to echo.

entries.name: Deathlock
entries.desc:
Increases the execution threshold of Guard-Broken enemies by 5%. Executing an enemy grants a 5% damage increase. Stacks up to 2 times, with each stack lasting 10 seconds.

Nothing about it suggests it is anything more than a lump of scrap iron. Yet it bears the scars of countless battles, as though forged from the shattered remains of fallen armor. Somehow, it still holds the power to "cut down evil."

entries.name: Treasure Basin
entries.desc:
Increases the amount of Remnant Dust dropped by 10%.

After the decline of the Lóng Clan, many of the family's treasured relics were scattered. One such relic lay hidden at the bottom of Meigu Lake until repairs to the White Serpent House brought it back into the light.

entries.name: Sharpshooter's Eye
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Increases damage dealt to enemies beyond a certain distance by 15%. When active, the lock-on reticle flashes red.

The one-eyed sharpshooter, feeling himself no longer worthy of bearing this once-prized pendant, left it behind in the hope that whoever came after would put it to good use.

entries.name: Venom Pouch
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
All Main Weapon attacks have a 15% chance to poison enemies.

A curious pouch fashioned from eerie fish hide and venomous deep-water creatures. At the slightest squeeze, the Blackwater Crew's secret poison seeps forth, ready to coat a blade whenever needed. After all, those that dwell beneath the water are always a shade more insidious than those on land.

entries.name: Sundering Dual Axes
entries.desc:
The shorter the blade, the greater the peril. Standard combos build Baleful Aura, unleashing cold, ever-changing reaping attacks.

A pair of deadly axes once wielded by Heartpiercer, Elite Shadow Warden.

entries.name: Whiteshadow
entries.desc:
A shadowless blade with a gleam as cold as snow.

A long blade sharp enough to cut through iron, once wielded by the Blizzard Blademaster

entries.name: War Wagon
entries.desc:
A war wagon left behind by Old Man Gen, built for charging through enemy lines or swiftly traversing the land.

An armored war wagon left behind by Old Man Gen.

entries.name: One-eyed Bow
entries.desc:
What appears to be a bow is in fact possessed by an unknown entity from the Discordance, allowing it to unleash otherworldly death rays.

An elegantly crafted longbow once wielded by the One-Eyed Archer.

entries.name: Loong Trident
entries.desc:
The signature weapon of You Loong, leader of the Blackwater Crew. Its Loong-fang prongs can be thrown over long distances and are equally deadly against enemies lurking beneath the water. Deals increased damage to enemies at full HP

A Loong-fang trident once wielded by You Loong, leader of the Blackwater Crew.

entries.name: Rouge Box
entries.desc:
After consuming Sha-Chi, reduces the delay before regeneration begins by 50%.

The rouge inside was a gift from Jin to his younger sister, Xiu. It caught his eye as he passed a shop, and he knew at once that she would love the color. Yet the rouge became tainted by the Sha-Chi that clung to Jin, and now seems redder than ever.

entries.name: Sha-Chi Blood Catalyst
entries.desc:
A combat stimulant that Quick Hand Zhang acquired from members of the Blackwater Crew last year. Despite its remarkable effects, it causes Sha-Chi to seep into the bloodstream, burning like fire. Yet many ferrymen and boatmen of Meigu Lake rely on it to make their living amid the wind and waves.

IncreasesSha-Chi Combo damage by 20% for 15 seconds and restores 20% HP, but ignites you.

entries.name: Longevity Tonic
entries.desc:
Originally a medicinal drink transported by merchants, it was stolen by bandits along the way. The bandits treasured it as a rare curiosity, but knowing nothing of its ingenious mechanism, they went to their graves without ever tasting a single drop.

Restores all HP.

Backstreet Courtyard Key
entries.desc:
A small key left behind by the Maskwalker, Chen Zhu. It doesn't seem to have been used much.

Opens the gate to a courtyard in Pangzhen's backstreets.

entries.name: Shrine Gate Key
entries.desc: The key to the mountain gate on the only path to the shrine. It was hidden within the caverns by Huangxing's personal guards.

entries.name: Missing Lift Crank
entries.desc:
The crank missing from the lift along the mountain path to the summit. The Mandate built the lift to move supplies to the shrine at the top. Later, Huangxing's personal guards removed the crank to conceal the shrine's secrets.

After a struggle for possession, it seems to have ended up with a ruthless madwoman.

entries.name: Detached Cage Lever
entries.desc: A rusted iron lever appears to have come loose from some larger mechanism. Despite its condition, it may yet prove key to some other mechanism.

entries.name: Desperate Stand
entries.desc:
The lower your HP, the greater your damage increase, up to 25%.

Red threads creep into bare bone, while dried blood feeds the will to kill. Only those willing to wager their broken bodies against death can unleash a strike with no turning back.

entries.name: Baishan Writ
entries.how: Hidden in a breakable rubbish pile
entries.desc:
Increases Sha-Chi depletion against enemies by 5%.

From Baishan comes a spirit hound, sword in its jaws, sworn to pierce deception and slay evil. This writ was carried by a Baishan guard while secretly tracking Huangxing. To those who recognize it, the bearer is to be treated like the Sect Master herself.

entries.name: Seamless Death
entries.desc:
A pair of uncanny ring blades whose strikes flow with effortless fluidity. They can be hurled to claim lives in an instant.

A pair of uncanny ring blades once wielded by the Jade-Face

entries.name: Juggernaut
entries.desc:
A vicious blade that once swept the streets of the town. It has high shield-breaking power and accumulate [Red Edge] to unleash a powerful attack.

A heavy saber once wielded by Bi Feng, Giant Saber Commander.

entries.name: Ink Cut
entries.desc:
Moji's sword, left behind after his passing. It channels Chi to command the blade, cleansing the world of corruption.

A jet-black sword once wielded by Moji.

entries.name: Flying Guillotine
entries.desc:
Huangxing's lethal specialized weapon conceals blades within and deploys razor-sharp edges along its rim. It has high shield-breaking power and can take an enemy's head in an instant.

A specialized weapon once wielded by Huangxing.

entries.name: Inanis' Radiant Fan
entries.desc:
A wondrous blossom fan gifted by Inanis, capable of creating a sanctuary anywhere.

An ornate war fan gifted by Inanis within the Realm of Mirage.

entries.name: Talisman of Despair
entries.desc:
The next attack gains up to 25% damage over 4 seconds. Hitting an enemy resets the effect.

No one knows when this peach pit, entrusted with hopes of a safe return home, came to bear a grotesque, ghostly face. Perhaps it has witnessed too much despair... those who succumbed to forbidden arts, those who placed their hopes in them, and those forced to practice them.

entries.name: Crude Radiant Heart
entries.desc:
Any  attack that hits an enemy builds temporary  Remnant Spark. Martial-type Phantom Edges consume temporary  Remnant Spark first.

A heart-shaped Mindseal implanted in Lu Sanqian's chest. More refined than its predecessors, it was designed to preserve the immense power granted by Transcension while minimizing the madness it induces.

Soulrend Storeroom Key
entries.desc: A standard key often carried by members of the Mandate. The endless wind and snow of Soulrend Mountain have cracked the metal, yet the groove along its teeth still gleams like new.
entries.dead: The game's map table puts this key in a rubbish pile that is not in any level of the game, and nothing else gives the key (only its storeroom door uses it). The player checked the spot in game: nothing there.

entries.name: The Lady's Fan
entries.desc:
A bone fan once wielded by Meng Hua before she became The Lady. It channels the powers of Ice, Fire, Lightning, and Chaos. A weapon unlike any other in the Wulin.

A sinister fan once wielded by Meng Hua, the Merciful Lady of the Blossom Veil.

entries.name: Bonesaw
entries.desc:
Its coarse, jagged teeth have high shield-breaking power. It never grants a swift end to enemies.

A bloodthirsty weapon once wielded by the Saw, a Shadow Warden of the Order.

entries.name: Aureate
entries.desc:
A longsword forged from pure gold, its blade smooth as silk. With it, one can imitate Zuo Shang's unique Golden Sword Energy.

A pure-gold longsword, smooth as silk, once wielded by Zuo Shang.
